topics.title: Stern and Ennis Discuss Explicit Fantasies
topics.summary: Howard Stern and Roy Ennis engage in an increasingly explicit conversation revolving around sexual fantasies involving various body parts, including gynecological examinations and bizarre scenarios. They discuss inviting lesbian Nazi guests to call in, with a focus on anticipating potential insults from callers.

topics.title: Stern vs. Eymus - Radio Debate
topics.summary: During a radio segment, callers passionately debate the similarities between Howard Stern and John Eymus, arguing over whether Stern copied Eymus’s style and ratings success. The conversation quickly devolves into personal anecdotes about dating experiences, frustrations with Tom's program director selection, and an extended discussion involving Fred the Elephant Boy.

topics.title: Stern Discusses Personal Items
topics.summary: Howard Stern discusses his collection of unusual personal items including a uterus tire clasp and nipple-toured shoes during an interview with Gary. He expresses frustration about being misunderstood and makes crude remarks regarding his wife.

topics.title: Howard Stern Discusses Headaches & Movie Plans
topics.summary: During a live broadcast, Howard Stern describes his ongoing headaches stemming from rain and lack of sleep. He outlines plans to write and film an ambitious movie treatment with 25 pages, involving potential co-stars like John Mulroney, and recounts anecdotes about phone number inquiries and a frustrating interaction with his wife.

topics.title: Nightly Cataloging and Fantasies
topics.summary: A man recounts his nightly routines, detailing encounters with women including tissue usage, highballs, and recurring fantasies centered around figures like Dana Plato or Irene the hippie girl while struggling to maintain boundaries. The conversation is marked by confusion about practical details such as toilet paper use and a general lack of awareness regarding personal limits.

topics.title: Nightly Lectures and Dice's Unusual Request
topics.summary: Howard recounts his nightly routine of talking with his wife until late, followed by lectures on her day planning. He then receives a call from Dice Clay who requests he publicly state he won’t appear at Dangerfield’s during prom season.
